subject: Recap: Pilot milestones, decision owners, and docs we promised
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearmap.io>, Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@clearmap.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Pilot milestones, decision owners, and docs we promised

Hi Emily / Ryan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick write-up to capture the pain, goals, and the proposed milestone plan so we have a single source of truth.

Short summary (what we heard)
- Pain: Clearmap is seeing variable inference latency at peak (up to 4–6s 95th for batch jobs), and unpredictable per-token costs across different workloads. Sensitive data routing and tenant isolation are also blockers for production.
- Goal: Run a 6-week pilot that validates predictable 95th latency <= 2s for typical queries, measures per-token cost improvements with caching/batching, and validates a deployment pattern that satisfies your security team (VPC + KM integration).

Proposed mutual plan (milestones & owners)
1) Kickoff & scope confirmation (by Jun 12) — Owner: Emily Zhang (Clearmap) & Monica Patel (Redwood)
   - Outcome: signed pilot SOW (baseline scope), security checklist accepted, procurement contact introduced.
2) Pilot deployment (Jun 15 — Jul 10) — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood eng) + Clearmap dev lead
   - Outcome: Dedicated pilot environment, baseline perf run, instrumentation enabled.
3) Performance evaluation & cost analysis (Jul 11 — Jul 17) — Owner: Monica Patel + Clearmap analytics
   - Outcome: 95th latency report, cost per 1k tokens, recommended quantization/variant.
4) Exec review & decision (by Jul 24) — Owner: Emily Zhang + Clearmap procurement
   - Outcome: Go/no-go decision, path to Dedicated or Hosted.

Immediate asks from Redwood (action items)
- Can you introduce procurement contact (if not Ryan) and your security reviewer? (Emily)
- Confirm that the Clearmap dev team can provision network access (VPC peering or PrivateLink) for the pilot environment.
- We attached a SOW template and a short pilot scope sheet to make the sign-off quick.

Attachments: [Clearmap_SOW_template_v1.pdf], [redwood_pilot_scope.xlsx] (attached)

Next suggested meeting: Jun 8 or Jun 9 to finalize SOW and agree on kickoff date. I can do Jun 8 after 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this ahead.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.example | +1 (415) 555-0127

Subject: Re: Recap: Pilot milestones, decision owners, and docs we promised

Thanks Monica — very helpful summary. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Scope tweak: our security team prefers pilot runs on a logically isolated Dedicated pool (even for the pilot) because of PHI-like data profiles. Would you be able to provision that for a 6-week pilot?
- Procurement: adding Ryan Cole (cc) as primary for contracting. Ryan — can you confirm the typical timeline for SOW review on your end?
- Questions: Can you give us a ballpark monthly run-rate for the pilot (dedicated) so we can budget? A rough estimate is fine at this stage.

We should aim to lock the kickoff week-of Jun 15 if you can do Jun 15 or Jun 17 — those work better for our dev team.

Emily Zhang
Head of Data Product, Clearmap Analytics

Emily — thanks for the note and the ask. Short answers:
- Dedicated pilot: yes, we can provision a logically isolated Dedicated pool for the pilot duration.
- Ballpark cost: for a 6-week Dedicated pilot sized for ~10k requests/day with expected batch patterns, estimate is ~$11k–16k/month depending on model variant and quantization. I attached a one-page snapshot with example configs.
- Commercials: we typically provide a small onboarding credit and can roll the pilot SOW into an enterprise commitment if you decide to go forward.

I've attached pricing_snapshot.pdf for context. Once Ryan confirms procurement timelines, Monica and I will send a draft SOW for review.

DocuSign link for quick SOW: https://docusign.example/redwood/CLRM-238 (we'll send a formal link when draft is ready)

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 15:42:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Pilot milestones, decision owners, and docs we promised

Emily / team — quick technical follow-up and checklist for the pilot environment so we can hit the milestones on schedule:
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink; please share the CIDR ranges and preferred method.
- IAM/KMS: confirm whether Clearmap will bring keys (KMS) or if you want Redwood-managed keys for the pilot. We support both; KMS handshake will add ~3 business days.
- Telemetry: we request API keys for metrics collection and a short-lived read-only S3 bucket for logs (or enable Log Forwarding). This avoids pulling production logs.
- Model variant: we recommend running with the 'redwood-latency-1b-q4' variant for initial perf runs, then test 'redwood-balanced-3b' for accuracy/cost tradeoffs.
- Test set: please share ~500 representative queries and expected token distributions; we'll run synthetic and real runs.

I'll upload a technical-runbook (templates + tests) to our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-clearmap-pilot-docs (permission will be granted to emily.zhang@clearmap.io & procurement@clearmap.io).

If Jun 15 works for kickoff, we'll aim to have the pilot environment ready within 3 business days after SOW signature.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
